headline: Virginia and Oregon sue Elon Musk companies over Grok AI sexualized images
label: NEWS
caption:
Virginia and Oregon have become the first US states to take legal action against Elon Musk companies over AI generated images 🚨

According to reports from AP News and Anadolu, the states are suing over a flood of sexualized images made using the Grok AI chatbot.

The lawsuits target companies associated with Musk following concerns raised about the generation and spread of nonconsensual digital content.

State officials argue that the technology poses serious risks and harms by producing explicit material without consent.
